response.justification: Despite extensive full-stack and cross-platform experience, the candidate lacks demonstrable C++ expertise in industrial automation contexts, with only a brief, non-detailed mention of C++ in a 6-month role at National Instruments; core requirements like STL, multi-threading, message brokers, IEC 62443, and industrial protocols are absent from the resume, and the candidate’s recent work is dominated by TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang — not aligned with the role’s C++-centric, security-compliant, on-prem/cloud industrial platform focus.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems.
Proven track record in open-source contributions and technical mentorship through workshops and public talks.
Demonstrated ability to build scalable, event-driven systems and contribute to DevOps infrastructure.
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (only 6 months at NI, no recent use); no evidence of STL, concurrency, or OOP in modern C++ contexts.
No mention of message brokers, MQTT, REST in industrial systems, or IEC 62443/SDL security standards.
Primary tech stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang — no cloud (Azure), IoT protocols (OPC UA, Modbus), or industrial automation exposure.
